answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the summit of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. The bridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
